intents.title: Support hours
responses: Our team works **Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM IST**. Messages sent on weekends are answered on the next working day.
intents.with_faq: Messages sent on weekends are answered on the next working day.
intents.more: If it is urgent, email hello@datheon.in with your Application ID in the subject so the team can find you quickly.

intents.title: Submitting your project
responses: Push your code to a **public GitHub repository** named `Datheon_Python_Programming_Internship`, add a short README.md, then paste the link in the submission form in your **Student Workspace** and tick the tasks you completed.
intents.with_faq: Name the repo `Datheon_Python_Programming_Internship`, add a short README.md, and tick the tasks you completed in the form.
intents.more: You can edit or resubmit the link for **24 hours** after submitting. After that it is locked for evaluation, so double-check that every task is in the repo first.

intents.title: Certificates
responses: Certificates are reviewed and issued within **3–5 business days** after your code review. Each one is a **Verified Certificate of Completion** with a QR code anyone can scan to check it.
intents.with_faq: Each one is a **Verified Certificate of Completion** with a QR code anyone can scan to check it.
intents.more: Completing the project also qualifies you for a Performance Scorecard and an official Letter of Recommendation.

intents.title: Tasks and requirements
responses: The Python Programming Internship has **4 tasks**: a Hangman game, a Stock Portfolio Tracker, a File Organizer and a Rule-Based Chatbot. You need to complete **at least 2 or 3** of them.
intents.more: Open any task in your Student Workspace to see its full problem statement, suggested approach and the dataset to download.

intents.title: Duration and deadline
responses: The internship runs for **4 weeks (28 days)**. Your clock only starts when you click **Start Project** in the Student Workspace, and your exact deadline is shown at the top of the workspace.
intents.more: The four weeks are: Setup & Foundations, Core Engineering, Advanced Features, then Submission & Audit. It is self-paced, so you can finish early.

intents.title: Fees
responses: Good news: there is **no enrollment fee and no evaluation fee**. The internship and the code review are free.
intents.more: If anyone asks you to pay to receive your Datheon certificate, please report it to hello@datheon.in.

intents.title: LinkedIn and recommendation letters
responses: Sharing a screenshot or demo video on **LinkedIn** and tagging **@Datheon** is an optional bonus, and it helps **top performers qualify for a Letter of Recommendation (LOR)**.
intents.more: Paste the post link in the 'LinkedIn Post URL' box of the submission form so the reviewers can see it.

intents.title: Pausing the internship
responses: You can **pause** the internship from your Student Workspace (the Pause button at the top) if exams or other plans get in the way, and continue later.
intents.more: Pausing keeps all your work. Just remember to resume before your deadline.

intents.title: Application ID and login
responses: Sign in to the **Student Workspace** with your registered email and your **Application ID** (it looks like `DT-2026-XXXXX`). There is no password.
intents.more: Can't find your ID? Search your mailbox for "Datheon" or "DT-2026" (it is in your offer letter), or email hello@datheon.in.

intents.title: Contacting the team
responses: You can reach the team at **hello@datheon.in** (general) or **admissions@datheon.in** (internship questions). You can also simply reply to any Datheon email.
intents.more: Please include your Application ID so they can find your workspace quickly.

intents.title: GitHub help
responses: Quick GitHub steps: **1)** github.com/new → name it `Datheon_Python_Programming_Internship` → Public. **2)** In your project folder: `git init`, `git add .`, `git commit -m "Datheon tasks"`. **3)** `git remote add origin <your repo URL>` then `git push -u origin main`.
intents.more: Make sure the repo is **Public** so the evaluators can open it, and add a README.md that explains each task.

intents.title: Other programs
responses: Datheon runs project-based internships in areas such as **Python programming, AI systems and automation**. You can browse every program in the **Catalog** on datheon.in.
intents.more: Each program follows the same model: choose tasks, build them, submit a public GitHub repo and get a verified certificate.
